notes: UNSW Sydney uses the standard DHA 4-question framework (150 words max per answer) inside its branded 'Genuine Student (GS) Declaration' form. No unique structure override required.
sources: web:18 UNSW India/Pakistan GS Financial Declaration PDF

structure.instruction: Detail your ties to your home country, including family, community, employment, and economic circumstances.
Detail why you wish to study this specific course at UNSW, including your understanding of program requirements and why you chose UNSW Sydney over other institutions.
Explain how completing this program will benefit your future career, including employment prospects and salary expectations in your home country.
Provide any other relevant details regarding your academic history, study gaps, or circumstances that support your application.
